Q1.rationale: The Recipient uses Confidential Information only in connection with the stated Purpose.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: If the Recipient is required by a regulator, government authority or court to disclose, it must promptly notify the Disclosing Party.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: The definition is not limited to written form and covers circumstances of disclosure, and oral transfers are referenced in the export clause, though verbal disclosure is not stated expressly.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: The 24-month post-termination non-compete survives termination, so some obligations survive.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: The definition lists many non-technical items, including business information, so it is not limited to technical information.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: No license or right to Confidential Information is granted by the Agreement or by disclosure.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation covenant.
Q7.label: NotMentioned

Q8.rationale: The NDA contains no restriction on disclosing the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q8.label: NotMentioned

Q9.rationale: The NDA has no residuals clause; use of Confidential Information is restricted to the Purpose, and residuals are not addressed.
Q9.label: NotMentioned

Q13.rationale: Disclosure to consultants and contractors is permitted with written authorization and equivalent confidentiality obligations; agents and professional advisors are not expressly listed.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: The NDA restricts disclosure to contract workers and consultants but does not expressly address sharing with the Recipient's own employees.
Q14.label: NotMentioned

Q16.rationale: Disclosing Party retains all rights and the Confidential Information and derivative materials remain its property, which is incompatible with transfer of ownership to the Recipient.
Q16.label: Contradiction

Q17.rationale: The NDA expressly contemplates the Recipient receiving information from other parties that is similar to the Confidential Information.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: Copies may be made as reasonably required for the Purpose.
Q18.label: Entailment

Q19.rationale: The NDA expressly permits disclosure in confidence to government officials to report suspected violations of law, so there is an exception.
Q19.label: Contradiction

Q20.rationale: Remedies are injunctive relief; no fixed sum or penalty is payable on breach.
Q20.label: NotMentioned
